title: pos.payment.method — POS Payment Method Types, Session Close Accounting L3

key_findings.type_field: computed from journal_id.type: cash/bank=journal type, else=pay_later
key_findings.qr_code_support: payment_method_type='qr_code' with bank journal + bank_account_id; uses res.partner.bank.build_qr_code_base64()
key_findings.session_statement_id: DOES NOT EXIST — pos.session has statement_line_ids (One2many) not statement_id; each line has pos_session_id M2O back-link
key_findings.cash_close_path: account.bank.statement.line per payment in cash journal; counterpart = POS intermediary receivable or customer receivable (split)
key_findings.bank_close_path: account.payment per payment_method (combine) or per payment+partner (split); outstanding_account_id → receivable_account
key_findings.split_transactions: field labelled 'Identify Customer'; splits journal entries per customer; cash=statement line per partner; bank=account.payment per partner
key_findings.pay_later_path: receivable lines in move_id only; no statement lines, no account.payment; excluded for invoiced orders
key_findings.thai_l10n_pos_interaction: l10n_th does NOT extend pos.payment.method; Thai QR works through standard qr_code type + Thai bank account proxy (ewallet_id/merchant_tax_id/mobile)
key_findings.write_guard: all fields except sequence are locked when open_session_ids is non-empty

awt_items.description: Verify runtime QR code generation in POS session: confirm get_qr_code() is called from the OWL frontend at payment time and the generated base64 QR is displayed to the customer
awt_items.reason: QR display and polling logic is in JavaScript/OWL layer; Python source only covers server-side generation

awt_items.description: Verify cash difference posting at session close: confirm profit/loss statement line appears in the accounting journal entry and reconciles correctly against the cash register
awt_items.reason: Profit/loss account assignment depends on journal configuration; runtime reconciliation requires a live session test

function_ids: SCHEMA-PM-TYPE-COMPUTE: type computed from journal_id.type cash/bank/pay_later
SCHEMA-PM-JOURNAL: journal_id cash or bank only; auto-set outstanding on bank select
SCHEMA-PM-COMPANY: company_id default env.company; config company constraint
SCHEMA-PM-OUTSTANDING: outstanding_account_id bank transit account ondelete=restrict
SCHEMA-PM-RECEIVABLE: receivable_account_id optional intermediary override reconcilable receivable
SCHEMA-PM-SPLIT: split_transactions Identify Customer per-customer journal entries
SCHEMA-PM-IS-CASH: is_cash_count stored compute type==cash
GUARD-PM-CASH-SINGLE-SHOP: one cash method per pos.config constraint
GUARD-PM-WRITE-OPEN-SESSION: all fields except sequence locked during open session
SCHEMA-PM-TERMINAL: use_payment_terminal Selection empty in Community
SCHEMA-PM-QR: payment_method_type none/terminal/qr_code; qr_code requires bank+bank_account
FLOW-PM-QR-GENERATE: get_qr_code delegates to bank_account_id.build_qr_code_base64
SCHEMA-PAYMENT-FIELDS: pos_order_id+amount+payment_method_id+payment_date+session_id+is_change
SCHEMA-PAYMENT-CARD-FIELDS: card_type/brand/no/cardholder/ref_no/authcode/issuer/mode/txn_id/status/ticket
SCHEMA-PAYMENT-ACCOUNT-MOVE: account_move_id M2O btree_not_null for split invoiced payments
FLOW-SESSION-CLOSE-ENTRY: _create_account_move creates session move in config journal
FLOW-ACCUMULATE-AMOUNTS: 6 buckets split/combine x cash/bank/pay_later
FLOW-CASH-STATEMENT-LINES: account.bank.statement.line per cash payment; counterpart=intermediary or customer receivable
FLOW-BANK-PAYMENT-MOVES: account.payment combine=per-method+outstanding; split=per-partner+customer receivable
FLOW-GET-RECEIVABLE-ACCOUNT: payment_method.receivable_account_id or company default POS receivable
FLOW-VALIDATE-SESSION: orchestrates close: accumulate→create entries→post difference→post move→reconcile
FLOW-CASH-DIFFERENCE: _post_statement_difference profit_account_id or loss_account_id
FLOW-CASH-DIFFERENCE-REGISTER: cash_register_difference = balance_end_real - balance_end
FLOW-RECONCILE-LINES: _reconcile_plan cash statement+receivable; bank payment+receivable; invoice receivable pairs
ARCH-SESSION-STATEMENT-LINES: no statement_id on session; account.bank.statement.line has pos_session_id M2O
ARCH-PAY-LATER: receivable lines only; no statement; no account.payment; invoiced excluded
ARCH-BANK-DIFF-SPLIT-PM: split bank methods get separate diff move at close
ARCH-THAI-QR-LOCALIZATION: l10n_th extends res.partner.bank for PromptPay EMV QR tag 29 THB-only
ARCH-THAI-L10N-NO-POS-EXTEND: l10n_th depends account only; no pos.payment.method extension
FLOW-ACTION-CLOSING-CONTROL: state→closing_control; no-cash-control→skip to close; rescue→total cash; validate
